policies.name: authorization_audit_events_read
policies.using: ((EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM memoriesql.current_authorization_context() context(context_id, backend_pid, transaction_id, tenant_id, workspace_id, credential_id, principal_id, principal_kind, user_id, on_behalf_of_user_id, pairing_grant_id, membership_revision, pairing_grant_revision, expires_at, created_at) WHERE ((context.tenant_id = authorization_audit_events.tenant_id) AND (context.workspace_id = authorization_audit_events.workspace_id) AND ((context.principal_id = authorization_audit_events.authenticated_principal_id) OR ((context.user_id IS NOT NULL) AND (context.user_id = authorization_audit_events.on_behalf_of_user_id)) OR ((authorization_audit_events.access_scope_id IS NOT NULL) AND memoriesql.current_context_scope_permits(authorization_audit_events.access_scope_id, 'read'::text)))))) AND memoriesql.current_context_has_capability('audit.read'::text))

policies.name: bead_statement_revisions_read
policies.using: (memoriesql.current_context_event_authorized(access_scope_id, event_id, 'memory.query'::text, 'read'::text) AND memoriesql.current_context_bead_revision_authorized(tenant_id, workspace_id, access_scope_id, bead_id, statement_watermark))

policies.name: bead_topic_links_read
policies.using: (memoriesql.current_context_bead_version_authorized(tenant_id, workspace_id, access_scope_id, bead_version_id) AND memoriesql.current_context_bead_version_authorized(tenant_id, workspace_id, access_scope_id, evidence_bead_version_id) AND memoriesql.current_context_topic_authorized(tenant_id, workspace_id, access_scope_id, topic_id) AND memoriesql.current_context_topic_revision_authorized(tenant_id, workspace_id, access_scope_id, topic_id, topic_revision_id))

policies.name: captured_source_ranges_inspection
policies.using: (memoriesql.current_context_source_authorized(access_scope_id, source_object_id, 'source.raw.read'::text, 'read'::text) AND (current_setting('memoriesql.raw_detail_request_id'::text, true) IS NOT NULL) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM (memoriesql.current_authorization_context() context(context_id, backend_pid, transaction_id, tenant_id, workspace_id, credential_id, principal_id, principal_kind, user_id, on_behalf_of_user_id, pairing_grant_id, membership_revision, pairing_grant_revision, expires_at, created_at) JOIN memoriesql.authorization_audit_events audit ON (((audit.tenant_id = context.tenant_id) AND (audit.workspace_id = context.workspace_id) AND (audit.authenticated_principal_id = context.principal_id) AND ((audit.request_id)::text = current_setting('memoriesql.raw_detail_request_id'::text, true)) AND (audit.resource_kind = 'source'::text) AND (audit.resource_id = captured_source_ranges.source_object_id) AND (audit.capability_key = 'source.raw.read'::text) AND (audit.permission_key = 'read'::text) AND (audit.decision = 'allowed'::text) AND (audit.recorded_at >= transaction_timestamp())))))))

policies.name: entity_aliases_read
policies.using: (memoriesql.current_context_entity_authorized(tenant_id, workspace_id, access_scope_id, entity_id) AND memoriesql.current_context_bead_version_authorized(tenant_id, workspace_id, access_scope_id, evidence_bead_version_id))

policies.name: entity_external_reference_events_read
policies.using: (memoriesql.current_context_bead_version_authorized(tenant_id, workspace_id, access_scope_id, evidence_bead_version_id) AND ((target_entity_id IS NULL) OR memoriesql.current_context_entity_authorized(tenant_id, workspace_id, access_scope_id, target_entity_id)))

policies.name: entity_external_references_read
policies.using: (memoriesql.current_context_entity_authorized(tenant_id, workspace_id, access_scope_id, entity_id) AND memoriesql.current_context_bead_version_authorized(tenant_id, workspace_id, access_scope_id, evidence_bead_version_id))

policies.name: entity_identity_events_read
policies.using: (memoriesql.current_context_entity_authorized(tenant_id, workspace_id, access_scope_id, entity_id) AND ((target_entity_id IS NULL) OR memoriesql.current_context_entity_authorized(tenant_id, workspace_id, access_scope_id, target_entity_id)) AND memoriesql.current_context_bead_version_authorized(tenant_id, workspace_id, access_scope_id, evidence_bead_version_id))

policies.name: entity_mention_resolutions_read
policies.using: ((EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM memoriesql.entity_mentions mention WHERE ((mention.tenant_id = entity_mention_resolutions.tenant_id) AND (mention.entity_mention_id = entity_mention_resolutions.entity_mention_id) AND memoriesql.current_context_event_authorized(mention.access_scope_id, mention.event_id, 'source.read'::text, 'read'::text)))) AND ((resolved_entity_id IS NULL) OR memoriesql.current_context_entity_authorized(tenant_id, workspace_id, access_scope_id, resolved_entity_id)) AND ((resolution_status <> 'ambiguous'::text) OR memoriesql.current_context_entity_candidates_authorized(tenant_id, workspace_id, access_scope_id, entity_mention_resolution_id)) AND memoriesql.current_context_bead_version_authorized(tenant_id, workspace_id, access_scope_id, evidence_bead_version_id))

policies.name: entity_resolution_candidates_read

policies.name: entity_revisions_read
policies.using: (memoriesql.current_context_entity_authorized(tenant_id, workspace_id, access_scope_id, entity_id) AND memoriesql.current_context_bead_version_authorized(tenant_id, workspace_id, access_scope_id, evidence_bead_version_id))

policies.name: file_objects_read
policies.using: ((status = 'active'::text) AND memoriesql.current_context_scope_authorized(access_scope_id, 'file.read'::text, 'read'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM memoriesql.protected_resources resource WHERE ((resource.tenant_id = file_objects.tenant_id) AND (resource.workspace_id = file_objects.workspace_id) AND (resource.access_scope_id = file_objects.access_scope_id) AND (resource.resource_kind = 'file'::text) AND (resource.resource_id = file_objects.file_id) AND (resource.status = 'active'::text)))))

views.definition: SELECT approval.tenant_id, approval.workspace_id, approval.access_scope_id, approval.approval_id, approval.forecast_id, approval.forecast_hash, approval.source_scope_hash, approval.assumptions_hash, approval.quality_policy_revision_id, approval.model_profile_key, approval.model_profile_revision, approval.safety_ceiling_microunits, approval.approved_by_principal_id, approval.idempotency_key, approval.approved_at, forecast.forecast_series_key, NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM memoriesql.model_bulk_usage_forecasts newer WHERE newer.tenant_id = forecast.tenant_id AND newer.forecast_series_key = forecast.forecast_series_key AND newer.forecast_sequence > forecast.forecast_sequence)) AND approval.forecast_hash = forecast.forecast_hash AND approval.source_scope_hash = forecast.source_scope_hash AND approval.assumptions_hash = forecast.assumptions_hash AND approval.quality_policy_revision_id = forecast.quality_policy_revision_id AND approval.model_profile_key = forecast.model_profile_key AND approval.model_profile_revision = forecast.model_profile_revision AND NOT approval.safety_ceiling_microunits IS DISTINCT FROM forecast.safety_ceiling_microunits AS approval_valid FROM memoriesql.model_bulk_forecast_approvals approval JOIN memoriesql.model_bulk_usage_forecasts forecast ON forecast.tenant_id = approval.tenant_id AND forecast.forecast_id = approval.forecast_id;

views.definition: SELECT tenant_id, workspace_id, access_scope_id, module_key, request_recorded_at::date AS usage_day, count(*) AS request_count, sum(input_tokens) AS input_tokens, sum(output_tokens) AS output_tokens, sum(total_tokens) AS total_tokens, sum(shadow_catalog_cost_microunits) AS shadow_catalog_cost_microunits, sum(incremental_cash_exposure_microunits) AS incremental_cash_exposure_microunits, count(*) FILTER (WHERE incremental_cash_exposure_microunits IS NULL) AS unknown_incremental_cash_request_count, array_agg(request_id ORDER BY request_recorded_at, request_id) AS contributing_request_ids, jsonb_object_agg(request_id::text, to_jsonb(contributing_event_ids) ORDER BY request_recorded_at, request_id) AS contributing_event_ids_by_request, 1 AS fold_version FROM memoriesql.model_request_usage_fold GROUP BY tenant_id, workspace_id, access_scope_id, module_key, (request_recorded_at::date);
views.name: model_module_daily_usage_rollup

views.definition: SELECT tenant_id, workspace_id, access_scope_id, module_key, operation_key, request_recorded_at::date AS usage_day, count(*) AS request_count, sum(input_tokens) AS input_tokens, sum(output_tokens) AS output_tokens, sum(total_tokens) AS total_tokens, sum(shadow_catalog_cost_microunits) AS shadow_catalog_cost_microunits, sum(incremental_cash_exposure_microunits) AS incremental_cash_exposure_microunits, count(*) FILTER (WHERE incremental_cash_exposure_microunits IS NULL) AS unknown_incremental_cash_request_count, array_agg(request_id ORDER BY request_recorded_at, request_id) AS contributing_request_ids, jsonb_object_agg(request_id::text, to_jsonb(contributing_event_ids) ORDER BY request_recorded_at, request_id) AS contributing_event_ids_by_request, 1 AS fold_version FROM memoriesql.model_request_usage_fold GROUP BY tenant_id, workspace_id, access_scope_id, module_key, operation_key, (request_recorded_at::date);
views.name: model_operation_daily_usage_rollup

views.definition: SELECT intent.tenant_id, intent.workspace_id, intent.access_scope_id, intent.request_id, intent.task_id, intent.attempt_id, intent.run_id, intent.parent_run_id, intent.module_key, intent.operation_key, intent.task_kind, intent.model_profile_key, intent.model_profile_revision, intent.provider_key, intent.model_id, intent.billing_basis, intent.allowance_state, intent.pricing_revision_id, intent.quality_policy_revision_id, intent.quality_tier, intent.recorded_at AS request_recorded_at, CASE WHEN usage_event.event_id IS NOT NULL THEN usage_event.usage_state WHEN outcome_event.event_id IS NOT NULL THEN outcome_event.usage_state ELSE 'uncertain'::text END AS usage_state, COALESCE(usage_event.usage_provenance, outcome_event.usage_provenance, 'unavailable'::text) AS usage_provenance, COALESCE(outcome_event.outcome, 'unknown'::text) AS outcome, usage_event.input_tokens, usage_event.output_tokens, usage_event.total_tokens, usage_event.cached_input_tokens, usage_event.cache_write_tokens, usage_event.reasoning_tokens, usage_event.tool_calls, cash_event.provider_reported_cost_microunits, pricing.currency AS shadow_currency, CASE WHEN usage_event.usage_state = 'reported'::text AND pricing.pricing_revision_id IS NOT NULL THEN memoriesql.catalog_model_cost_microunits(usage_event.input_tokens, usage_event.cached_input_tokens, usage_event.cache_write_tokens, usage_event.output_tokens, pricing.input_microunits_per_million_tokens, pricing.cached_input_microunits_per_million_tokens, pricing.cache_write_microunits_per_million_tokens, pricing.output_microunits_per_million_tokens) ELSE NULL::bigint END AS shadow_catalog_cost_microunits, CASE WHEN cash_event.provider_reported_cost_microunits IS NOT NULL THEN cash_event.provider_reported_cost_microunits WHEN intent.billing_basis = 'subscription'::text AND intent.allowance_state = 'covered'::text THEN 0::bigint WHEN intent.billing_basis = 'metered'::text AND usage_event.usage_state = 'reported'::text AND pricing.pricing_revision_id IS NOT NULL THEN memoriesql.catalog_model_cost_microunits(usage_event.input_tokens, usage_event.cached_input_tokens, usage_event.cache_write_tokens, usage_event.output_tokens, pricing.input_microunits_per_million_tokens, pricing.cached_input_microunits_per_million_tokens, pricing.cache_write_microunits_per_million_tokens, pricing.output_microunits_per_million_tokens) ELSE NULL::bigint END AS incremental_cash_exposure_microunits, CASE WHEN cash_event.provider_reported_cost_microunits IS NOT NULL THEN 'provider_reported'::text WHEN intent.billing_basis = 'subscription'::text AND intent.allowance_state = 'covered'::text THEN 'subscription_covered'::text WHEN intent.billing_basis = 'local'::text THEN 'local'::text WHEN intent.billing_basis = 'metered'::text AND usage_event.usage_state = 'reported'::text AND pricing.pricing_revision_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'catalog_estimate'::text ELSE 'unknown'::text END AS incremental_cash_cost_basis, intent.conservative_reservation_microunits, CASE WHEN outcome_event.event_id IS NULL THEN 'held_uncertain'::text ELSE 'event_observed'::text END AS reservation_state, COALESCE(event_ids.contributing_event_ids, ARRAY[]::uuid[]) AS contributing_event_ids, 1 AS fold_version FROM memoriesql.model_provider_request_intents intent LEFT JOIN memoriesql.model_pricing_revisions pricing ON pricing.pricing_revision_id = intent.pricing_revision_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT event.tenant_id, event.workspace_id, event.access_scope_id, event.event_id, event.request_id, event.dedupe_key, event.event_kind, event.outcome, event.usage_state, event.usage_provenance, event.input_tokens, event.output_tokens, event.total_tokens, event.cached_input_tokens, event.cache_write_tokens, event.reasoning_tokens, event.tool_calls, event.provider_reported_cost_microunits, event.provider_reported_currency, event.provider_request_id_hash, event.diagnostic_code, event.recorded_at FROM memoriesql.model_usage_events event WHERE event.tenant_id = intent.tenant_id AND event.request_id = intent.request_id AND event.usage_state = 'reported'::text ORDER BY event.recorded_at DESC, event.event_id DESC LIMIT 1) usage_event ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT event.provider_reported_cost_microunits FROM memoriesql.model_usage_events event WHERE event.tenant_id = intent.tenant_id AND event.request_id = intent.request_id AND event.provider_reported_cost_microunits IS NOT NULL ORDER BY event.recorded_at DESC, event.event_id DESC LIMIT 1) cash_event ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT event.event_id, event.outcome, event.usage_state, event.usage_provenance FROM memoriesql.model_usage_events event WHERE event.tenant_id = intent.tenant_id AND event.request_id = intent.request_id ORDER BY event.recorded_at DESC, event.event_id DESC LIMIT 1) outcome_event ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT array_agg(event.event_id ORDER BY event.recorded_at, event.event_id) AS contributing_event_ids FROM memoriesql.model_usage_events event WHERE event.tenant_id = intent.tenant_id AND event.request_id = intent.request_id) event_ids ON true;
views.name: model_request_usage_fold

views.definition: SELECT tenant_id, workspace_id, access_scope_id, task_id, attempt_id, run_id, count(*) AS request_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE usage_state = 'reported'::text) AS reported_request_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE usage_state = 'uncertain'::text) AS uncertain_request_count, sum(input_tokens) AS input_tokens, sum(output_tokens) AS output_tokens, sum(total_tokens) AS total_tokens, sum(tool_calls) AS tool_calls, sum(shadow_catalog_cost_microunits) AS shadow_catalog_cost_microunits, sum(incremental_cash_exposure_microunits) AS incremental_cash_exposure_microunits, count(incremental_cash_exposure_microunits) AS known_incremental_cash_request_count, array_agg(request_id ORDER BY request_recorded_at, request_id) AS contributing_request_ids, jsonb_object_agg(request_id::text, to_jsonb(contributing_event_ids) ORDER BY request_recorded_at, request_id) AS contributing_event_ids_by_request, 1 AS fold_version FROM memoriesql.model_request_usage_fold GROUP BY tenant_id, workspace_id, access_scope_id, task_id, attempt_id, run_id;
views.name: model_run_usage_rollup

views.definition: SELECT tenant_id, workspace_id, access_scope_id, task_id, attempt_id, count(*) AS request_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE usage_state = 'reported'::text) AS reported_request_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE usage_state = 'uncertain'::text) AS uncertain_request_count, sum(input_tokens) AS input_tokens, sum(output_tokens) AS output_tokens, sum(total_tokens) AS total_tokens, sum(tool_calls) AS tool_calls, sum(shadow_catalog_cost_microunits) AS shadow_catalog_cost_microunits, sum(incremental_cash_exposure_microunits) AS incremental_cash_exposure_microunits, count(incremental_cash_exposure_microunits) AS known_incremental_cash_request_count, array_agg(request_id ORDER BY request_recorded_at, request_id) AS contributing_request_ids, jsonb_object_agg(request_id::text, to_jsonb(contributing_event_ids) ORDER BY request_recorded_at, request_id) AS contributing_event_ids_by_request, 1 AS fold_version FROM memoriesql.model_request_usage_fold GROUP BY tenant_id, workspace_id, access_scope_id, task_id, attempt_id;
views.name: model_task_attempt_usage_rollup

views.definition: SELECT tenant_id, workspace_id, access_scope_id, task_id, count(*) AS request_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE usage_state = 'reported'::text) AS reported_request_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE usage_state = 'uncertain'::text) AS uncertain_request_count, sum(input_tokens) AS input_tokens, sum(output_tokens) AS output_tokens, sum(total_tokens) AS total_tokens, sum(tool_calls) AS tool_calls, sum(shadow_catalog_cost_microunits) AS shadow_catalog_cost_microunits, sum(incremental_cash_exposure_microunits) AS incremental_cash_exposure_microunits, count(incremental_cash_exposure_microunits) AS known_incremental_cash_request_count, array_agg(request_id ORDER BY request_recorded_at, request_id) AS contributing_request_ids, jsonb_object_agg(request_id::text, to_jsonb(contributing_event_ids) ORDER BY request_recorded_at, request_id) AS contributing_event_ids_by_request, 1 AS fold_version FROM memoriesql.model_request_usage_fold GROUP BY tenant_id, workspace_id, access_scope_id, task_id;
views.name: model_task_usage_rollup

views.definition: SELECT COALESCE(requests.request_count, 0::bigint) AS request_count, COALESCE(runs.request_count, 0::numeric) AS run_rollup_request_count, COALESCE(requests.total_tokens, 0::numeric) AS request_total_tokens, COALESCE(runs.total_tokens, 0::numeric) AS run_rollup_total_tokens, COALESCE(requests.shadow_cost, 0::numeric) AS request_shadow_cost_microunits, COALESCE(runs.shadow_cost, 0::numeric) AS run_rollup_shadow_cost_microunits, COALESCE(attempts.request_count, 0::numeric) AS attempt_rollup_request_count, COALESCE(attempts.total_tokens, 0::numeric) AS attempt_rollup_total_tokens, COALESCE(attempts.shadow_cost, 0::numeric) AS attempt_rollup_shadow_cost_microunits, COALESCE(tasks.request_count, 0::numeric) AS task_rollup_request_count, COALESCE(tasks.total_tokens, 0::numeric) AS task_rollup_total_tokens, COALESCE(tasks.shadow_cost, 0::numeric) AS task_rollup_shadow_cost_microunits, COALESCE(modules.request_count, 0::numeric) AS module_rollup_request_count, COALESCE(modules.total_tokens, 0::numeric) AS module_rollup_total_tokens, COALESCE(operations.request_count, 0::numeric) AS operation_rollup_request_count, COALESCE(operations.total_tokens, 0::numeric) AS operation_rollup_total_tokens, COALESCE(workspaces.request_count, 0::numeric) AS workspace_rollup_request_count, COALESCE(workspaces.total_tokens, 0::numeric) AS workspace_rollup_total_tokens, COALESCE(requests.request_count, 0::bigint)::numeric = COALESCE(runs.request_count, 0::numeric) AND COALESCE(requests.total_tokens, 0::numeric) = COALESCE(runs.total_tokens, 0::numeric) AND COALESCE(requests.shadow_cost, 0::numeric) = COALESCE(runs.shadow_cost, 0::numeric) AND COALESCE(requests.request_count, 0::bigint)::numeric = COALESCE(attempts.request_count, 0::numeric) AND COALESCE(requests.total_tokens, 0::numeric) = COALESCE(attempts.total_tokens, 0::numeric) AND COALESCE(requests.shadow_cost, 0::numeric) = COALESCE(attempts.shadow_cost, 0::numeric) AND COALESCE(requests.request_count, 0::bigint)::numeric = COALESCE(tasks.request_count, 0::numeric) AND COALESCE(requests.total_tokens, 0::numeric) = COALESCE(tasks.total_tokens, 0::numeric) AND COALESCE(requests.shadow_cost, 0::numeric) = COALESCE(tasks.shadow_cost, 0::numeric) AND COALESCE(requests.request_count, 0::bigint)::numeric = COALESCE(modules.request_count, 0::numeric) AND COALESCE(requests.total_tokens, 0::numeric) = COALESCE(modules.total_tokens, 0::numeric) AND COALESCE(requests.shadow_cost, 0::numeric) = COALESCE(modules.shadow_cost, 0::numeric) AND COALESCE(requests.request_count, 0::bigint)::numeric = COALESCE(operations.request_count, 0::numeric) AND COALESCE(requests.total_tokens, 0::numeric) = COALESCE(operations.total_tokens, 0::numeric) AND COALESCE(requests.shadow_cost, 0::numeric) = COALESCE(operations.shadow_cost, 0::numeric) AND COALESCE(requests.request_count, 0::bigint)::numeric = COALESCE(workspaces.request_count, 0::numeric) AND COALESCE(requests.total_tokens, 0::numeric) = COALESCE(workspaces.total_tokens, 0::numeric) AND COALESCE(requests.shadow_cost, 0::numeric) = COALESCE(workspaces.shadow_cost, 0::numeric) AS parity_ok, 1 AS fold_version FROM ( SELECT count(*) AS request_count, sum(model_request_usage_fold.total_tokens) AS total_tokens, sum(model_request_usage_fold.shadow_catalog_cost_microunits) AS shadow_cost FROM memoriesql.model_request_usage_fold) requests CROSS JOIN ( SELECT sum(model_run_usage_rollup.request_count) AS request_count, sum(model_run_usage_rollup.total_tokens) AS total_tokens, sum(model_run_usage_rollup.shadow_catalog_cost_microunits) AS shadow_cost FROM memoriesql.model_run_usage_rollup) runs CROSS JOIN ( SELECT sum(model_task_attempt_usage_rollup.request_count) AS request_count, sum(model_task_attempt_usage_rollup.total_tokens) AS total_tokens, sum(model_task_attempt_usage_rollup.shadow_catalog_cost_microunits) AS shadow_cost FROM memoriesql.model_task_attempt_usage_rollup) attempts CROSS JOIN ( SELECT sum(model_task_usage_rollup.request_count) AS request_count, sum(model_task_usage_rollup.total_tokens) AS total_tokens, sum(model_task_usage_rollup.shadow_catalog_cost_microunits) AS shadow_cost FROM memoriesql.model_task_usage_rollup) tasks CROSS JOIN ( SELECT sum(model_module_daily_usage_rollup.request_count) AS request_count, sum(model_module_daily_usage_rollup.total_tokens) AS total_tokens, sum(model_module_daily_usage_rollup.shadow_catalog_cost_microunits) AS shadow_cost FROM memoriesql.model_module_daily_usage_rollup) modules CROSS JOIN ( SELECT sum(model_operation_daily_usage_rollup.request_count) AS request_count, sum(model_operation_daily_usage_rollup.total_tokens) AS total_tokens, sum(model_operation_daily_usage_rollup.shadow_catalog_cost_microunits) AS shadow_cost FROM memoriesql.model_operation_daily_usage_rollup) operations CROSS JOIN ( SELECT sum(model_workspace_daily_usage_rollup.request_count) AS request_count, sum(model_workspace_daily_usage_rollup.total_tokens) AS total_tokens, sum(model_workspace_daily_usage_rollup.shadow_catalog_cost_microunits) AS shadow_cost FROM memoriesql.model_workspace_daily_usage_rollup) workspaces;
views.name: model_usage_fold_reconciliation

views.definition: SELECT tenant_id, workspace_id, request_recorded_at::date AS usage_day, count(*) AS request_count, sum(input_tokens) AS input_tokens, sum(output_tokens) AS output_tokens, sum(total_tokens) AS total_tokens, sum(shadow_catalog_cost_microunits) AS shadow_catalog_cost_microunits, sum(incremental_cash_exposure_microunits) AS incremental_cash_exposure_microunits, count(*) FILTER (WHERE incremental_cash_exposure_microunits IS NULL) AS unknown_incremental_cash_request_count, array_agg(request_id ORDER BY request_recorded_at, request_id) AS contributing_request_ids, jsonb_object_agg(request_id::text, to_jsonb(contributing_event_ids) ORDER BY request_recorded_at, request_id) AS contributing_event_ids_by_request, 1 AS fold_version FROM memoriesql.model_request_usage_fold GROUP BY tenant_id, workspace_id, (request_recorded_at::date);
views.name: model_workspace_daily_usage_rollup

views.definition: SELECT observation.tenant_id, observation.workspace_id, observation.access_scope_id, observation.bead_id, observation.event_id, observation.source_object_id, observation.source_unit_id, observation.source_type, observation.source_system, observation.unit_kind, COALESCE(observation.unit_source_occurred_at, observation.source_occurred_at, observation.captured_at) AS effective_at, CASE WHEN observation.unit_source_occurred_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'unit_source_time'::text WHEN observation.source_occurred_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'event_source_time'::text ELSE 'capture_time'::text END AS time_basis, unit_record.unit_time_precision, event_record.source_time_precision AS event_time_precision, observation.source_sequence, observation.unit_ordinal, observation.captured_at, observation.recorded_at AS known_at FROM memoriesql.thin_observations observation JOIN memoriesql.source_units unit_record ON unit_record.tenant_id = observation.tenant_id AND unit_record.source_unit_id = observation.source_unit_id JOIN memoriesql.source_events event_record ON event_record.tenant_id = observation.tenant_id AND event_record.event_id = observation.event_id;
views.name: observation_timeline

views.definition: SELECT COALESCE(max(version), 0) AS current_version, count(*) AS applied_migration_count, max(applied_at) AS last_migrated_at FROM memoriesql.schema_migrations;
views.name: schema_version

views.definition: SELECT task.tenant_id, task.workspace_id, task.access_scope_id, task.task_id, task.owning_module, task.task_kind, task.contract_revision, task.queue_name, task.target_kind, task.status, task.pause_reason_code, task.attempt_count, task.result_attempt_id, task.result_ref, task.result_hash, task.cancel_requested_at, task.created_at, task.updated_at, task.started_at, task.completed_at, COALESCE(run_counts.run_count, 0::bigint) AS run_count, COALESCE(run_counts.settled_run_count, 0::bigint) AS settled_run_count, outcome.authority_class AS outcome_authority_class FROM memoriesql.semantic_tasks task LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) AS run_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE run.settled) AS settled_run_count FROM memoriesql.semantic_task_runs run WHERE run.tenant_id = task.tenant_id AND run.task_id = task.task_id AND run.attempt_id = COALESCE(task.result_attempt_id, ( SELECT attempt.attempt_id FROM memoriesql.semantic_task_attempts attempt WHERE attempt.tenant_id = task.tenant_id AND attempt.task_id = task.task_id ORDER BY attempt.attempt_number DESC LIMIT 1))) run_counts ON true LEFT JOIN memoriesql.semantic_synthetic_outcomes outcome ON outcome.tenant_id = task.tenant_id AND outcome.task_id = task.task_id;
views.name: semantic_async_operations

views.definition: SELECT task.tenant_id, task.workspace_id, task.queue_name, task.task_kind, count(*) FILTER (WHERE (task.status = ANY (ARRAY['queued'::text, 'retry_wait'::text])) AND task.available_at <= statement_timestamp() AND task.cancel_requested_at IS NULL AND memoriesql.current_context_semantic_task_origin_authorized(task.task_id, statement_timestamp()) AND COALESCE(control.state, 'enabled'::text) = 'enabled'::text) AS ready_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE task.status = 'running'::text) AS running_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE task.status = 'policy_paused'::text) AS paused_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE task.status = 'dead_letter'::text) AS dead_letter_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE task.status = 'running'::text AND task.lease_expires_at <= statement_timestamp()) AS expired_lease_count, min(task.created_at) FILTER (WHERE (task.status = ANY (ARRAY['queued'::text, 'retry_wait'::text])) AND task.available_at <= statement_timestamp() AND task.cancel_requested_at IS NULL AND memoriesql.current_context_semantic_task_origin_authorized(task.task_id, statement_timestamp()) AND COALESCE(control.state, 'enabled'::text) = 'enabled'::text) AS oldest_ready_at FROM memoriesql.semantic_tasks task LEFT JOIN memoriesql.semantic_module_queue_controls control ON control.tenant_id = task.tenant_id AND control.workspace_id = task.workspace_id AND control.owning_module = task.owning_module GROUP BY task.tenant_id, task.workspace_id, task.queue_name, task.task_kind;
views.name: semantic_queue_health

views.definition: SELECT tenant_id, workspace_id, access_scope_id, task_id, attempt_id, attempt_number, lease_generation, claimant_principal_id, worker_id, worker_instance_id, status, result_status, error_code, error_class, retry_class, retry_after, claimed_at, started_at, finished_at FROM memoriesql.semantic_task_attempts attempt;
views.name: semantic_task_attempt_history

views.definition: SELECT tenant_id, workspace_id, access_scope_id, task_id, owning_module, task_kind, queue_name, attempt_count, max_attempts, result_attempt_id, completed_at FROM memoriesql.semantic_tasks task WHERE status = 'dead_letter'::text;
views.name: semantic_task_dead_letters

views.definition: SELECT tenant_id, workspace_id, access_scope_id, task_id, attempt_id, run_id, parent_run_id, delegation_id, run_role, sibling_order, agent_key, input_contract_id, input_contract_revision, input_contract_hash, output_contract_id, output_contract_revision, output_contract_hash, model_profile_key, model_profile_revision, effort_key, run_status AS status, delegation_status, settled, started_at, finished_at, delegation_started_at, delegation_finished_at FROM memoriesql.semantic_task_runs run;
views.name: semantic_task_run_tree

views.definition: SELECT tenant_id, workspace_id, access_scope_id, task_id, owning_module, task_kind, queue_name, attempt_count, lease_owner, worker_instance_id, lease_generation, heartbeat_at, lease_expires_at, cancel_requested_at, started_at FROM memoriesql.semantic_tasks task WHERE status = 'running'::text;
views.name: semantic_tasks_active

views.definition: SELECT task.tenant_id, task.workspace_id, task.access_scope_id, task.task_id, task.owning_module, task.task_kind, task.contract_revision, task.queue_name, task.base_priority, task.base_priority::bigint + LEAST('4294967296'::bigint::numeric, floor(EXTRACT(epoch FROM statement_timestamp() - task.created_at) / 30::numeric))::bigint AS effective_priority, task.available_at, task.attempt_count, task.max_attempts, task.created_at FROM memoriesql.semantic_tasks task LEFT JOIN memoriesql.semantic_module_queue_controls control ON control.tenant_id = task.tenant_id AND control.workspace_id = task.workspace_id AND control.owning_module = task.owning_module WHERE (task.status = ANY (ARRAY['queued'::text, 'retry_wait'::text])) AND task.available_at <= statement_timestamp() AND task.cancel_requested_at IS NULL AND memoriesql.current_context_semantic_task_origin_authorized(task.task_id, statement_timestamp()) AND COALESCE(control.state, 'enabled'::text) = 'enabled'::text;
views.name: semantic_tasks_ready

views.definition: SELECT event_record.tenant_id, event_record.workspace_id, event_record.access_scope_id, event_record.event_id, event_record.observation_unit_count AS declared_observation_unit_count, count(unit_record.source_unit_id) AS source_unit_count, count(unit_record.source_unit_id) FILTER (WHERE unit_record.is_observation) AS observation_unit_count, count(bead.bead_id) AS bead_count FROM memoriesql.source_events event_record LEFT JOIN memoriesql.source_units unit_record ON unit_record.tenant_id = event_record.tenant_id AND unit_record.event_id = event_record.event_id LEFT JOIN memoriesql.beads bead ON bead.tenant_id = unit_record.tenant_id AND bead.source_unit_id = unit_record.source_unit_id GROUP BY event_record.tenant_id, event_record.workspace_id, event_record.access_scope_id, event_record.event_id, event_record.observation_unit_count;
views.name: source_event_cardinality

views.definition: SELECT bead.tenant_id, bead.workspace_id, bead.access_scope_id, bead.bead_id, bead.event_id, event_record.source_object_id, bead.source_unit_id, event_record.source_type, event_record.source_system, event_record.source_identity_key, unit_record.unit_kind, unit_record.external_unit_id, unit_record.unit_ordinal, unit_record.parent_unit_id, unit_record.content_text, unit_record.content_hash AS unit_content_hash, event_record.content_hash AS event_content_hash, unit_record.hydration_ref, unit_record.unit_source_occurred_at, unit_record.unit_source_occurred_end_at, event_record.source_occurred_at, event_record.source_occurred_end_at, event_record.source_sequence, event_record.captured_at, event_record.recorded_at, bead.created_at FROM memoriesql.beads bead JOIN memoriesql.source_units unit_record ON unit_record.tenant_id = bead.tenant_id AND unit_record.source_unit_id = bead.source_unit_id JOIN memoriesql.source_events event_record ON event_record.tenant_id = bead.tenant_id AND event_record.event_id = bead.event_id;
views.name: thin_observations

views.definition: SELECT tenant_id, workspace_id, access_scope_id, topic_id, target_topic_id, topic_identity_event_id, valid_from, valid_to FROM memoriesql.current_context_topic_redirect_history() current_context_topic_redirect_history(tenant_id, workspace_id, access_scope_id, topic_id, target_topic_id, topic_identity_event_id, valid_from, valid_to);
